description: This file declares utility functions related to media processing, specifically for identifying video and audio decoders and retrieving underflow signal names within the Rialto server component.

methods.name: isVideoDecoder
methods.description: Determines if a given GstElement is a video decoder using the IGstWrapper interface.

methods.name: isAudioDecoder
methods.description: Determines if a given GstElement is an audio decoder using the IGstWrapper interface.

methods.name: getUnderflowSignalName
methods.description: Retrieves the signal name for underflow events for a GstElement using the IGlibWrapper interface.
